text:
Rita.AE: Quick sync Opal Pier POC. Customer wants to run opal-30b (upstream) in their colo with KV prefix caching and BYO HSM (PKCS#11). Target ~10 qps sustained. Need compatibility checklist, rough lead time, and ballpark pricing for Dedicated vs Private. Any immediate red flags?

Ben.SE: Short: opal-30b uses RMSNorm + grouped_gemm and a nonstandard rotary scale. We can do q8_0 but grouped_gemm perf path requires the kernel patch in runtime >=2.6. If they can't accept patched container, latency may be higher.

Leah.ML: Model work estimate: export + quantize + compile + smoke perf = ~2 business days if runtime supports patch. If runtime recompile is required on-site add 1 day. KV prefix caching default to ~2048 tokens; longer prefixes need kv-shard or prefix-slicing (+1 day). We can offer opal-lite (~13B distilled) as a lower-cost option.

Sam.Infra: On-prem checklist: NVIDIA driver >=525, CUDA >=12.1, container runtime >=1.6, and pkcs11 libs present. If air-gapped we can deliver image tarball (adds ~1 day). Please ask them for `nvidia-smi` and `ldconfig -p` outputs. I'll open a validation ticket once we have those.

Hector.Security: We support BYO HSM via PKCS#11 in Private with our KMS shim. Required artifacts: completed security questionnaire, network/dataflow diagram, SOC2 Type II, pen-test summary, and signed DPA. If they want zero-egress residency we need an SOW addendum covering image delivery and telemetry.

preflight-bot: INF-12177 created: recommended customer checks:
```
nvidia-smi --query-gpu=driver_version,name --format=csv
./validate_cuda.sh --min-version=12.1
ldconfig -p | grep -i pkcs11 || echo "pkcs11 missing"
```

Ben.SE: Cost note: rough hosted-equivalent for 4x H100s ~ $420-460/hr platform (ballpark). Private adds platform license + ops retainer for 24/7; SLA negotiable. I'll prepare a 10 qps calc for Dedicated vs Private and include opal-lite option.

Leah.ML: Timeline: 2 days model conversion + 1 day KV perf tuning + 1 day integration/docs + 1 day canary = ~5 business days after infra greenlight. If they require runtime recompile or air-gap image delivery add ~1-2 days.

Rita.AE: Action items: I'll request `nvidia-smi` + `ldconfig -p`, the filled security RFI, and whether they prefer Dedicated vs Private. Ben prepare cost/SOW stub; Leah reserve conversion slots; Hector will send RFI template and attestation for model residency. Thanks :thumbsup:

Ben.SE: On it. Also flag in SOW: without grouped_gemm kernel we may see 15-25% tail latency regression. Call that out.

Leah.ML: If they care more about cost than fidelity, opal-lite is a very practical tradeoff — mention it in the proposal.

Rita.AE: Great, I'll update after I get their env dump and RFI.
